about.en: Quran lessons (P29, C4.7): listen and repeat, Al-Fatiha and Juz 'Amma first, p1 to adults. Each lesson is its verses, named by number (ayah steps); the text, the translations of the meanings and the recitation come from the Quran set (content/quran), never typed here. Marked NC because the recitation is Islamic Network's (free, non-commercial redistribution). No lessons yet: they are drafted by a person with a Hanafi scholar, never by a tool or a model, and each verse needs its translation recorded by native Dari and Pashto speakers before release.
